catalog.title: Scribble Picture 23
catalog.description_raw: Digital Work, XH2 Fuji, Church Ave
catalog.caption: Church Ave
catalog.process_notes: Almost a year since the last scribble picture. Church Ave, Brooklyn.

described.alt_text: A photograph of a Brooklyn farmers market at Church and Beverley with a lamp post, white umbrellas and a brick building, where a pink two legged creature sits on the plaza, small creatures stand on the pavement, and a faceless man walks past, signed 24.
described.description: A portrait format digital piece on a photograph, signed Matt Crump 24 at lower right. A grey street lamp with a drawn curved head rises at left, its pole covered in drawn stickers and panels, with green street signs reading Church Av and Beverley. Outlined cartoon clouds float in a blue sky beside a large green tree. A brick corner building with a decorative gable stands at right, and a red brick row with a 99 sign at left. White market umbrellas shade tables of fruit and vegetables in the middle distance with a striped awning at right. On the painted plaza in the foreground a pink rounded creature with a red button eye sits with its back to the viewer, an orange traffic cone and red case sit beside the lamp base, which has a drawn face. Small grey and green pod creatures stand along the pavement, a tan one sits on a chair at right, and a man in a grey shirt walks past at right with his head replaced by a cream cartoon shape. A white metal bench sits at lower right.
described.impression: Back on Church Avenue a year later and the creatures have settled in: the pink one is just sitting watching the market like everybody else. The lamp post wears a face and the plaza is painted, so the whole corner feels like a stage after a parade. The first of the 2024 Scribbles, and warmer and busier with inhabitants than the 2023 ones.
described.format_notes: Digital drawing over a Fujifilm X-H2 photograph. First Scribble picture after a year's gap.
